source: Pochven: EVE University wiki, Triglavian Invasion (Chapter 3) and Invasion (https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/Triglavian_Invasion, https://wiki.eveuniversity.org/Invasion), read 2026-10-12: the 27 Final Liminality systems that became Pochven on 2020-10-13 (SDE build 3396210, mapSolarSystems region 10000070). Outside Pochven: the same Chapter 3 page names Arshat as the system that moved from Escalating Liminality to an EDENCOM Fortress (end of Chapter 3, 2020-10-13); the wiki does not give a current state for it, and no other K-space system is named with a state. The forum names of the 2020 renewed attacks (Abha, Inaya, Muttokon, Seiradih, Aldik, Iosantin) are not states and are not listed.
note: Each system listed here is a zone: its sentries and camps are placed when a ship first looks at it. A zone is held by 'triglavian' or 'edencom'. Skirmishes run in Pochven only.
